title: Register a co-operative
summary: This page outlines the steps and requirements for registering a new co-operative in NSW.
intro:
There are 3 steps to registering a new co-operative:

You can lodge the completed forms and supporting documents by email, mail, or in person at a service centre.

For detailed information on the documentation you need to complete this transaction visit About co-operatives on the NSW Fair Trading website.
who_can_apply: Two-thirds of prospective members must vote to adopt the rules at the formation meeting.
A proposed co-operative must have a membership.
what_you_need: Form 'Application to approve co-operative name, rules and formation disclosure statement'
At least 5 prospective members in attendance
The completed 'Application to Register a Co-operative' form
Registered office and postal addresses of the co-operative
Estimated financial details including share numbers and value, revenue, gross assets, and number of employees
Details of co-operative board members elected at the formation meeting
2 signed and certified copies of the rules
1 copy of signed and certified formation disclosure statement (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Gather your supporting documents and the completed 'Application to approve co-operative name, rules and formation disclosure statement'.
Submit the documents and completed form either:
When approval from the Registrar has been received:
Submit the signed 'Application to Register a Co-operative' form, rules and disclosure statement (if applicable), and application fee to Registry Services.

more_info.text: All members of a co-operative have equal status and voting rights.

faqs.q: Where can I submit my co-operative registration documents?
faqs.a: You can lodge the completed forms and supporting documents by email, mail, or in person at a service centre.

faqs.q: What is the first step to registering a co-operative?
faqs.a: The first step is to gather your supporting documents and the completed 'Application to approve co-operative name, rules and formation disclosure statement'.

faqs.q: What do I need to submit after the Registrar approves the name and rules?
faqs.a: You must submit the signed 'Application to Register a Co-operative' form, rules and disclosure statement (if applicable), and the application fee to Registry Services.
